reason: I'm on my own and already have more callers than I can handle, so 990 setup plus 149 a month (almost 1,800 a year) is too much for SMS replies I can partly do myself with a WhatsApp Business auto-reply. And I'm not handing my phone forwarding to two guys who don't have a single customer yet.
objection: Fiddling with my call forwarding and number makes me nervous. If their thing breaks or they go bust, my customers don't reach me, and I'm the one who has to sort it out with the phone company.
would_change_my_mind: A free month on my own number, set up in an afternoon, with references from other one-man shops nearby, and around 49 a month with no big setup fee.
